narr: Beginning around midday and continuing through afternoon, slow-moving isolated thunderstorms developed over Joshua Tree National Park, which sits at higher elevation. A few of the storms produced high rainfall rates and localized radar estimated rainfall amounts up to around 2 inches. This led to at least one report of flash flooding in the park.
ev: A park employee with Joshua Tree National Park share video and report of roads washed out in the Indian Cove section of the park. No damages or injuries were reported. Timing based on radar.
